description: Extract structured data from an invoice, receipt, purchase order, bank statement or other document with a ParserBee Parser Template. Give either file_path (a PDF or image on this computer) or file_url (a public link). Returns the extracted fields in `data`. Costs 1 ParserBee page credit per page. Use list_templates to find the template_id.

file_path.description: Absolute path to a local PDF, PNG, JPG, WebP or HEIC file

file_url.description: Public URL of the document (must open without a login)

template_id.description: ID of the Parser Template to use

name: extract_document
title: Extract data from a document
